explanation: The theorem is about the library's own Fock-space operators `creation`, `annihilation` (built from `left`, `mask`, `freeGen`, `Prefix` on `HilbertSum F2 H`), which are defined only in this repository; Mathlib has no notion of creation/annihilation operators on an l2 Hilbert sum (searches for `creation`, `annihilation`, `freeGen`, and `creation_orthogonal` in Mathlib returned nothing relevant). The Mathlib lemmas used in the proof (`ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right`, `lp.inner_eq_tsum`, `inner_zero_right`, `ext_inner_left`) are generic glue, not the mathematical content, so no duplicate or single-declaration special case exists.
